description: This file contains functions and definitions related to file system stat data manipulation, including copying stat data, comparing stat data, and managing stat data validity checks. It appears to be part of a larger source code project, likely related to Git or a similar version control system, given the context from included headers.

methods.name: unsigned int munge_st_size(off_t st_size)
methods.description: Converts the st_size from off_t to an unsigned int, with special handling for sizes that are multiples of 4 GiB.

methods.name: void fill_stat_data(struct stat_data * sd,struct stat * st)
methods.description: Populates a stat_data structure with information from a struct stat.

methods.name: void set_times(struct stat * st,const struct stat_data * sd)
methods.description: Sets the access and modification times of a struct stat from a stat_data structure.

methods.name: void fake_lstat_data(const struct stat_data * sd,struct stat * st)
methods.description: Fills a struct stat with data from a stat_data structure, mimicking the behavior of lstat.

methods.name: int match_stat_data(const struct stat_data * sd,struct stat * st)
methods.description: Compares stat_data with struct stat to determine if there have been changes.

methods.name: void stat_validity_clear(struct stat_validity * sv)
methods.description: Clears the stat data validity structure.

methods.name: int stat_validity_check(struct stat_validity * sv,const char * path)
methods.description: Checks if the current file at the given path matches the stored stat data validity data.

methods.name: void stat_validity_update(struct stat_validity * sv,int fd)
methods.description: Updates the stat data validity structure with current file info from an open file descriptor.

ctags.name: set_times
ctags.pattern: /^static void set_times(struct stat *st, const struct stat_data *sd)$/
